definitions.explanation: The rhythmic expansion and contraction of the heart or blood vessels. Primarily a medical and physiological term for the beating of the heart or pulse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{拍動|はくどう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{拍動|はくどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。

⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拍動|はくどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正常|せいじょう}→正常：03085_seijou⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor checked whether the patient's heartbeat was normal.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{拍|はく}→拍：30066_haku⟧ (beat; clap; rhythm) and {動|どう} (movement). Specifically refers to the rhythmic beating of the heart and blood vessels, making it more technical and narrower in scope than the related word ⟦{鼓動|こどう}→鼓動：19609_kodou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拍動|はくどう}: heartbeat
- {拍動|はくどう}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: pulse rate
- {拍動|はくどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧: pulse is fast
- {拍動|はくどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧: pulse is weak
- ⟦{不規則|ふきそく}→不規則：15651_fukisoku⟧な{拍動|はくどう}: irregular heartbeat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鼓動|こどう}→鼓動：19609_kodou⟧: heartbeat; throbbing — more literary and emotional; often used figuratively (⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鼓動|こどう}→鼓動：19609_kodou⟧ "the beating of one's heart" can imply excitement or emotion)
- ⟦{脈拍|みゃくはく}→脈拍：17839_myakuhaku⟧: pulse — the measurable pulse rate, often used with numbers (⟦{脈拍|みゃくはく}→脈拍：17839_myakuhaku⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ "pulse rate")
- ⟦{律動|りつどう}→律動：26244_ritsudou⟧: rhythmic movement — broader term for any regular cyclical motion, not limited to the heart
- ⟦{動悸|どうき}→動悸：06299_douki⟧: palpitations — specifically abnormal or noticeable heartbeat, often associated with anxiety or illness
